lina-sec: Quick check — kicked off an ownership pass for admin-level IAM roles in prod. Found ~73 roles without an explicit owner. Sharing my proposed plan: classify by last_used, outreach 7 days, canary prune for long-unused, escalate KMS-bound roles to sec review. Thoughts?
omar-iam: Can you paste the query and the raw list? I want to cross-check against service accounts and KMS bindings before we touch anything.
lina-sec: Sure — query I used (BigQuery):
```
-- ownerfinder: admin-role orphans
SELECT role_name, last_used, bindings, audit_log_sample
FROM `redwood-prod.iam.role_audit`
WHERE privilege_level = 'admin'
  AND owner IS NULL
ORDER BY last_used DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
sec-bot: Scan complete: 73 orphaned-admin roles found. Top-10 by last_used attached. severity=medium :eyes:
benji-ops: Agree with a staged approach. My suggestions: run a dry-run ownerfinder that generates GH issues for each candidate, then manual owner lookup for the top-10 by recency. Exclude infra service accounts and KMS-bound principals from automatic prune. cc @omar-iam
omar-iam: To confirm exclusion patterns — I'll join on KMS bindings and service accounts. Quick run command I plan to use:
```
./tools/ownerfinder \
  --project redwood-prod \
  --threshold 180d \
  --exclude-pattern "serviceAccount:kms@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --dry-run
```
lina-sec: Yes — add a 'last_invoked < 90d' priority flag so we triage recent-but-ownerless roles first. Benji — can you take the first pass on top-10? I'll open the outreach thread to owners@redwood and a GH repo for tracking.
benji-ops: :thumbsup: I'll take top-10. My triage steps: 1) query audit logs for last principal, 2) lookup team via SCIM/owner tags, 3) ping Slack with a template, 4) if no response in 7 days mark for canary prune. I'll also attach a sample GH issue template.
lina-sec: Important KMS note — if a role is only observed in key_authorize or key_decrypt flows and is bound narrowly to a key, DO NOT auto-prune. Escalate those to security review so we don't break key access. I'll add that as a checklist item to the runbook.
sec-bot: action: created runbook draft: /docs/runbooks/admin-owner-handoff.md (preview link) :white_check_mark:
omar-iam: Thanks — I'll push the KMS-binding join and a smoke-test of ownerfinder (dry-run) this afternoon and report results here.
